links.description: Tagline articulates the brand's positioning around smarter learning and growth, aligning with an AI-assisted education product.

The graduate robot + open book + 'AI' speech bubble motif signals an AI-powered education/learning product, consistent with Thinksy being an AI tutoring/learning platform (per repo context: AI tutor integration, curriculum generation, exam practice).
The app icon is the visual brand mark for the Thinksy application, displaying the wordmark 'Thinksy'.
Icon artwork depicts a smiling blue/navy AI robot wearing a graduation cap, standing atop an open book, with a speech bubble labeled 'AI'.
Icon includes the tagline text 'LEARN SMARTER, GROW FURTHER' beneath the wordmark.
